facts.text: Under Midland University's Four-Year Graduation Guarantee, students who enter as first-time full-time undergraduates and declare their major by the start of sophomore year are guaranteed completion of one major and one minor within four years.

sources.title: Graduation | Midland University Catalog
sources.quote: The Four-Year Graduation Guarantee applies to all full time undergraduate students entering college for the first time and their completion of one major and one minor, including majors that require on-time acceptance into a specific program of study.
